stanza: See how the infinite divides:
And the divers are not to blame
For the rift, spanning distant shores
You don’t know my name
But I know yours

rides.line: She's been running half her life, the chrome and steel she rides
stanza: Somewhere on a desert highway, she rides a Harley-Davidson
Her long blonde hair flying in the wind
She's been running half her life, the chrome and steel she rides
Colliding with the very air she breathes
The air she breathes

sides.songTitle: I Feel Like the Mother of the World
sides.line: There'd only be tears and sides
stanza: When I was a boy I used to get into it bad
With my sister
And when the time came to face the truth
There'd only be tears and sides
Tears and sides
And my mother my poor mother
Would say it does not matter
It does not matter
Just stop fighting

sides.line: They’re coming at you from all sides
stanza: They’re coming at you from all sides
To imprint your body and say they didn’t
The highest authority on Cheez Whiz
Hiding behind a Supreme Court urinal
There's an ocean that awaits us
Spreading out on all sides
We could swim
We could dissolve there

sides.line: Time everlasting, time to play B-sides
stanza: Time is the essence, time is the season
Time ain't no reason, got no time to slow
Time everlasting, time to play B-sides
Time ain't on my side, time I'll never know
